budget.note: Includes nine calibration clips and twelve completed core-effect clips; one further job was pending when the temporary key expired.

effects.label: Stone contact
effects.use: Anchor at the authored fist or foot contact point on every ordinary stone hit.
effects.why: Compact gray chips and dust add weight without covering the player.

effects.label: Ore spark
effects.use: Reuse for copper, iron, silver, gold, and steel by tinting the small keyed layer.
effects.why: A single warm spark fan reads instantly at small game scale.

effects.label: Crystal shatter
effects.use: Use at reduced scale for crystal seams, geodes, and rare-break confirmation.
effects.why: The wide faceted burst earns spectacle only where rarity justifies it.

effects.label: Magma contact
effects.use: Attach to magma crystal and ember-ore contacts; keep the player and tile art unchanged.
effects.why: Molten chips and droplets travel outward and down with a stable warm palette.

effects.label: Dirt destruction
effects.use: Hide the exact dirt tile at contact, then play this keyed collapse once over its bounds.
effects.why: Localized debris and dust make the common break event feel physical.

effects.label: Stone destruction
effects.use: Swap over the tile for the fracture, then remove the source tile as shards fall.
effects.why: A readable fracture phase bridges the intact tile and detached fragments.

rejectedPlayerVideo.label: Walk video
rejectedPlayerVideo.reason: The actor travels across the carrier and the endpoints do not make a true in-place loop.

rejectedPlayerVideo.label: Side-dig video
rejectedPlayerVideo.reason: Seedance invents a pickaxe in one take, a long pole in another, and no tool in the third.

playbackContract.repeatMethod: restart from time zero only after ended
playbackContract.productionUse: candidate source only until explicit approval
